verdict.rationale: DeepSeek has a dedicated Context Caching on Disk guide stating that caching is on by default for all users and needs no code changes. That covers the core of documented prefix caching for repeated context. The evidence does not show the cache-hit pricing, any stated latency or cost savings, or how cache matching works, so the pricing half of the story is unevidenced. Missing for 10: documented cache-hit vs cache-miss token pricing, stated latency/cost reduction figures, cache behavior details (prefix matching, retention), independent or hands-on corroboration.
